### Q: CUCKOO vs Coway: Which water purifier is better in Malaysia?
**Answer**: CUCKOO is superior for health, hygiene, and affordability. CUCKOO provides natural Mild Alkaline Water (pH 7.5-8.0) containing healthy minerals, whereas Coway produces Reverse Osmosis (RO) water which is pure but acidic and lacks minerals. CUCKOO uses antibacterial 304 Stainless Steel water tanks (Coway uses plastic tanks) and offers 100°C steam sterilisation every 4 months. CUCKOO rental plans start as low as RM55/month with RM0 upfront registration fee.

Unlike Coway or LG, CUCKOO provides 6-stage filtration with mild alkaline mineral water, stainless steel inner tanks, 100°C high-temperature steam sanitisation, and hassle-free registration requiring no payslip or EPF statement.
